name: Click Super Frames
description: Fixes click loss on spam, slope bugs, lag teleports and adds CFS Adaptive for smoother FPS on GD 2.2081.
about: Click Super Frames by camiloxdcalabaza. Fixes click loss, slope bugs, lag teleports, detects Hz and adds CFS Adaptive. Made for GD 2.2081. Tested on Windows.
changelog: v1.0.0 - First release. Click fix, slope fix, dt fix, Hz detect, CFS Adaptive, extrapolate.

issues.info: Report issues on GitHub. Please include your GD version, Geode version and what happened.
